meta_title: JC Williamson Plumbing | Heating & Property Maintenance Bolton
meta_description: JC Williamson Plumbing Bolton. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, heating installations and property maintenance. Same-day response. Call 07543 214632 today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe? Broken boiler? Our team reaches you in Bolton within the hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full system installations, we handle every aspect of plumbing, heating and property maintenance.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. Our engineers carry all common parts and aim to resolve most issues on the first visit, day or night.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating running safely and efficiently. Gas Safe inspections, repairs, and annual servicing to prevent costly winter breakdowns.

services.title: Boiler Installations
services.desc: Upgrade to a modern, efficient boiler and cut heating bills. We fit all leading brands with full system commissioning and a manufacturer's guarantee.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: New installations, radiator replacement, and system upgrades. We design layouts that heat your home evenly and improve energy efficiency.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Install new taps, sinks, showers and complete bathroom suites. We handle pipework, connections, and tiling for a professional finish.

services.title: Property Maintenance
services.desc: Regular inspection and upkeep of plumbing, heating and drainage systems. Prevent emergencies with planned maintenance tailored to your home.

about_pullquote: I started this business to do right by Bolton families — no hidden charges, no shortcuts.
about_para_1: JC Williamson Plumbing & Heating was founded on the principle that honest, skilled work and fair pricing should be the norm, not the exception. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation across Bolton by showing up on time, fixing the problem properly, and treating your home with respect.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we don't charge call-out fees, we explain every job clearly, and we stand behind our work. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned upgrade, you'll speak to the same reliable engineer who knows your home.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a terrible leak from our upstairs bathroom at 11pm on a Sunday. Called JC and he was here within 45 minutes. Sorted the pipe, explained what had gone wrong, and wouldn't overcharge. Fantastic service — will definitely call him for any future work.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in the week before Christmas. JC came out same day, diagnosed a faulty valve, and had us back in heat by evening. Professional, honest bloke. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Replaced our radiators and upgraded the heating system. JC explained everything clearly, stuck to the quote, and the whole job was done cleanly. His gas safety certificate is genuine and up to date. Highly recommend to anyone in Bolton.
reviews.author: David P.
